pages.description: Maintain subject lines, bodies, and channel settings for workspace notifications — with preview before publish.
pages.content: Notification Templates — Tracopus User Guide Home → Admin → Notification Templates Flowcharts flowchart TD A[Open templates] --> B[Filter by source/channel] B --> C[Open drawer] C --> D[Edit subject/body] D --> E[Preview] E --> F[Save] F --> G[Events use new copy] 1 Open templates Admin → Notification templates. 2 Filter Source (system/custom) and channel (email/in-app) narrow the register. 3 Edit in drawer Update subject, body, and placeholders carefully. 4 Preview Render sample HTML before saving. 5 Save Subsequent events pick up the new template. Overview Templates control outbound messaging for workspace events (approvals, notifications, and related workflows). System templates ship with the product; custom templates and overrides depend on org configuration. How to use 1. Prefer overrides over forks Adjust the existing event template when possible so keys stay aligned with the backend. 2. Keep placeholders intact Do not rename merge fields unless the event contract supports them. 3. Preview every change Broken HTML or empty subjects are the most common failures. 4. Test with a real event Trigger a sandbox approval or notification after saving. Related pages Admin dashboard Ops health overview. My Approvals Events that often use these templates. pages.title: Admin & Access
pages.description: Admin & Access — Tracopus user guide for enterprise work intelligence.
pages.content: Admin & Access — Tracopus User Guide Home → Admin & Access Chapter 9 · For admins & power users Admin & Access How permissions shape what you see in the Luxury UI — module menus, project scoping, timesheet date policies, and application configuration. Scenario pages document the same flags with step-by-step workflows in the Scenario User Guide . Access overview Tracopus uses role-based access control enforced on both client and server. The UI hides menus and actions you cannot use rather than showing disabled controls. Access is evaluated at multiple levels: Module level — can you see HRMS, Sales, or Project directories at all? Page level — which routes within a module appear in the sidebar? Persona level — which persona views you may switch into, and which pages each persona can open (org map + kill switches) Action level — create, edit, delete, assign, mark attendance, etc. Record level — project membership, team scope, shared vs private visibility Field level — timesheet date windows, report type availability Mobile receives an encrypted access control payload on login; web evaluates permissions from the authenticated user session. Persona access & navigation Tracopus separates who may use a persona (role) from org-wide page mapping and kill switches (organization). Surface Route Stores in What you configure Roles & permissions /admin/roles role.json → HRMS → personaModules Allowed personas, default persona, switcher; page preview writes the shared org page map. Screen guide: Roles & permissions . Simulator: Roles data flow . Persona navigation /admin/persona-navigation org.json → HRMS → personaNavigationAdditional Turn off personas/modules/pages; Page access — one page at a time, Product default vs Custom. Screen guide: Persona Navigation . Scenario: Turn off org access . Defaults Org seed: empty pagePersonaMap and empty disable lists — catalog sidebar personas[] apply until you customize a page. Site Admin role seed: all personas allowed, defaultPersona: ADMIN , switcher on. Evaluation order Role module / menu flags Role personaModules (or Automatic heuristic if never saved) Org pagePersonaMap override when present Org disabledPersonas / disabledPaths / disabledModules — always win Permission matrix on Roles stays under Advanced . Full key reference: personaNavigationAdditional and personaModules . Interactive: Roles simulator · Persona navigation simulator . Interactive data flow Trace personaModules (role layer) and personaNavigationAdditional (org layer) with live flag toggles. Role layer Roles simulator → Org layer Persona nav → All simulators Module access The left sidebar shows HRMS, Sales, and Project directories only when menuAccessControl flags them active for your user: Module Flag Typical roles HRMS hrmsModules.active All employees; HR admins see full directory Sales salesModules.active Sales, account managers, leadership Project projectModules.active Delivery, PMs, contributors Access-controlled routes These pages require additional permission flags beyond module access: File manager ( /project/filemanager ) Chat ( /project/chat ) Calendar ( /project/calendar ) Search ( /project/search ) Settings ( /hrms/settings ) Application config ( /hrms/appconfig ) Icon rail entries for these features hide when access is denied. Project access Team scope Team selection filters on list pages limit data to projects and records associated with selected teams. Your default team appears in the sidebar company chip. Project membership Project details enforce membership and team rules: Non-members may see read-only or denied views depending on shared visibility settings Cross-team access without membership renders read-only project details Members tab manages invitations, roles, and access chips Shared vs private projects Project list "Shared visibility" donut reflects how many projects are shared across teams vs restricted. Private projects appear only to members and elevated roles. Create permissions Create buttons on lists (projects, bids, POs, employees) and planner assign actions require explicit create permissions. Executive planner view is read-only when create is disabled. Timesheet access rules Timesheet permissions ( timeSheet branch of access control) govern web and mobile equally. Rule Effect enableTimeSheetEntry false No days allow entry — entire week disabled Project work item windows Billable entry only within min/max create dates derived from working-day offsets Non-project work item windows Separate date range for non-billable entries Leave/holiday rules allowLeaveAndHolidayForFuture / ForPast control leave booking direction Hour thresholds Rules like disable create before Y working days after X hours logged On mobile, disabled days show grey titles in the week list and blocked add buttons on the Record screen with snackbar message: "Time entry is not allowed for this date." Managers with multi-employee timesheet permission can switch employees on the web Timesheet page header. Application configuration /hrms/appconfig — hierarchical configuration tree per team (admin access required). What admins configure Application configuration (org.json) — dropdown lists, service line trees, notification emails, feature toggles, personaNavigationAdditional Access control (role.json) — module visibility, CRUD permissions, timesheet windows, report access, personaModules Team-scoped overrides inherited from parent org nodes with lock/hide/inherit controls Role bar for assigning role templates to org units during editing Dedicated UIs: Admin → Roles (persona-first) and Admin → Persona navigation (simplified Turn off / Page access) Open full Application Configuration reference → — every key from org.json and role.json with descriptions, sample values, and UI workflow notes. Organization settings /hrms/settings — Lux settings sections: Mobile devices Register and manage employee mobile device connections. Schedulers Cron job configuration for automated tasks. Service health Monitor integrated service status. Company Organization profile and branding metadata. Localization Locale and regional preferences. Notifications Org-wide notification defaults. Personal UI preferences (palette, font) live in the Settings right sidebar and localStorage — not org-wide. Reports & feedback permissions Report types in the REPORT dropdown are filtered by permission — users only see reports they can run. Feedback template configuration and campaign launch similarly require elevated project permissions. External feedback and invoice document routes ( /document/… ) use tokenized links that bypass full app auth for respondents while keeping responses scoped. ← Back to Home © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved. Documentation Scenario Guide Getting Started Charts For support, contact your workspace administrator.

pages.title: Charts & Analytics
pages.description: Charts & Analytics — Tracopus user guide for enterprise work intelligence.
pages.content: Charts & Analytics — Tracopus User Guide Home → Charts & Analytics Reference Charts & Analytics Complete reference for every chart and visualization in the Luxury UI — what type it is, what data it uses, and how to interpret it for decisions. Visual types explained Web charts render via ApexCharts unless noted. Mobile Insights uses fl_chart with matching Lux card styling. Type Best for How to read Where used Donut Part-to-whole ratios Each slice = category share; center label often shows total or primary metric Status mix, billing split, portfolio outcomes Bar (H/V) Ranking categories Longer bar = higher count; horizontal for long labels Top accounts, teams, priorities, skills Area Trends over time Filled line shows volume; slope = growth/decline Creation trends, daily load, joins/exits Line Precise time series Focus on rate of change between points Headcount trend, velocity, billable trend (mobile) Funnel Stage progression Width at each stage = volume; narrowing = drop-off Bid, PO, project, taskboard pipelines Heatmap Two-dimensional intensity Darker cell = higher value Deadline heatmap, roster heatmap Radar Multi-axis comparison Shape shows strengths/weaknesses across dimensions Personal performance radar Treemap Hierarchical share Rectangle area = proportion Grade/band, portfolio effort map Bubble / Scatter Correlation + size Position = X/Y metrics; bubble size = third dimension Risk scatter, estimate vs completion Radial bar Progress toward max Arc fill = % of capacity or completion Status radial, mobile progress ring Stacked bar Composition over time Segment height = sub-category within total Hours by type, mobile daily hours Dual line Two series comparison Gap between lines = variance Planned vs logged hours (mobile) Gauge / Dual gauge Single KPI % Fill arc to target threshold Mobile utilization & billable target CSS segment bar Simple status mix Colored segments without chart library Invoice status bar Filters affect all charts: Summary charts always reflect the current list filters (teams, SHOW preset, date range, text filter). Change filters to see charts recalculate for that slice. Project list charts Full panel list on Project List guide . Quick reference: Donut panels (10): By status, Portfolio mix, Timeline health, Billing mix, PO linkage, Completed share, Open pipeline load, Automation, Shared visibility, Capex/Opex, Hours estimated Bar panels (5): Project types (H), Top accounts (H), By team (H), Priority (V), Complexity (V) Area panels (1): Creation trend (6 months) Diagrams: Delivery funnel, stage flow, estimate gaps list Accounts directory charts Panel Type Data source Data health Donut Complete records vs needs attention (missing fields) Issue breakdown H-bar distributed Counts per quality issue type Record types Donut Account vs team vs client nodes Hierarchy coverage H-bar % % accounts with teams, teams with clients, clients with email Data source Donut Salesforce-sourced vs manually created Billing type Donut Billable classification split Top by clients H-bar Largest directory nodes by client count Sales charts Bid requests: 12 chart panels + vertical funnel — see Bid Requests guide . Purchase orders: 11 chart panels + delivery funnel — see Purchase Orders guide . PO detail page adds contract-level statistics donuts/bars in the Purchase Order Detail Statistics component. HRMS & employee charts Employee directory (9 panels) Treemap, line, stacked area, 2× donut, 2× column, 2× horizontal bar — detailed in Employees guide . Personal dashboard (4 chart panels + lists) Attendance strip, 6-week stacked hours, utilization donut, task queue donut. Team manager analytics Headcount line, join/exit area, gender/location/department bars, skills distribution. Invoices (CSS visuals) Status segment bar, monthly amount bars, outstanding summary — not Apex but same summary strip location. Tasks & planner charts Task board (5 panels) Funnel diagram, workflow donut, billable scope donut, flow bar, top categories bar. Task activity register (5 panels) Status, priority, checklist, type, outcome — donuts and bars. Team capacity overview (4 panels) Utilization bar, assignment donut, daily load dual area, free capacity bar. Assign-work insight (compact) Status donut, billable/leave donut, daily area, project horizontal bars, hourly bar. Work item activity detail popover Hourly logged vs planned bar for a single activity day. Executive project dashboard charts Most diverse chart set — types include area, radar, donut, bar, radialBar, treemap, bubble, polarArea, line, heatmap. Manager delivery lens highlights Risk scatter (bubble) Bubble X/Y position maps risk dimensions; bubble size = project effort or exposure. Outliers in the "high risk" quadrant need executive attention. Deadline heatmap Heatmap Rows = teams or owners; columns = time buckets; color intensity = count of deadlines due. Dark clusters indicate scheduling crunch periods. Velocity line Line Completed deliverables or projects over time — trend line slope reflects delivery throughput. Mobile Insights charts The mobile app mirrors web analytics in four sections. Chart widgets: LuxDonutChart, LuxDualGaugeRow, LuxStackedDailyHoursChart, LuxTrendLineChart, LuxDualLineChart, LuxTrendBarChart, LuxHorizontalBarChart. Section Charts Data Time & utilisation Dual gauges, hours mix donut, stacked daily hours, billable by project bars, time by account bars, billable trend line Timesheet week data Selected day Progress ring, stat tiles, status donut, priority bars, category bars Task activities for picked day Week trends Dual line (planned vs logged), task volume bars, completion bars, task type donut, effort by project bars, week status donut Week task activities Portfolio Summary tiles, portfolio donut, project status donut, projects by account bars, deliverables by project bars Projects in week range See Mobile Insights for interaction details (week bar, day strip, pull-to-refresh). pages.title: External project create API
pages.description: Issue a scoped integration token, then POST /api/v2/projects with that token. Sandbox vs production only changes the key prefix — scopes are the same live catalog.
headings: Connect an external service to create projects
pages.content: External project create API — Tracopus Documentation How it works An admin issues an integration token in Tracopus (UI or admin JWT curl). The secret is shown once . The external service stores tk_live_… or tk_test_… as a secret. Do not put it in source control. The service calls POST /api/v2/projects with Authorization: Bearer {secret} . Tracopus binds the write to the key’s team. userTeamId in the body must match that team (or omit it and the server fills it). createdBy is overwritten with the key’s service employee for audit. Integration keys cannot call /api/v2/developer-portal/* . Key issue/revoke stays on an admin session. Canonical chain Projects are not independent. Create against an existing purchase order in the same team: PurchaseOrder → Project → Task → TaskActivity Minimum body for a working create: { "name": "ERP project", "userTeamId": 101, "purchaseOrderId": 9001, "createdBy": 12 } Prerequisites Item Why Server flag FS_INTEGRATION_API_KEY_AUTH_ENABLED (default true ) Maps to fs.integration.api-key-auth.enabled . If false, tk_* tokens do not authenticate (401). Admin with Integrations → API access UI path /integrations/api-access (or Admin → API keys). Developer portal + integration center must be enabled for the org. Team id, purchase order id, service employee id The PO must already exist on that team. The employee on the key is used as createdBy . Scope projects.write projects.read cannot create. Extra sandbox scopes do not exist — only the catalog below. 1 · Issue the API key Preferred: Tracopus → Integrations → API access → Create token. Choose Production ( tk_live_ ) or Sandbox ( tk_test_ ), grant projects.write , copy the secret immediately. Or create with an admin JWT (not an integration key): POST /api/v2/developer-portal/api-keys Copy curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/api/v2/developer-portal/api-keys?userTeamId=TEAM_ID" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer ADMIN_JWT" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -H "Uid: EMPLOYEE_ID" \ -H "Current-User-Team-Id: TEAM_ID" \ -d '{ "name": "ERP project sync", "appName": "External ERP", "environment": "production", "scopes": ["projects.write"], "serviceEmployeeId": EMPLOYEE_ID, "createdByEmployeeId": EMPLOYEE_ID }' Field Required Notes userTeamId query Yes Team that owns the key. Project creates must use this same team. name Yes Audit label, e.g. ERP project sync . appName No Defaults to Custom integration . environment No production → tk_live_ . sandbox → tk_test_ . Same scopes either way. scopes Yes Must include projects.write to create projects. Non-catalog values are dropped. serviceEmployeeId Yes for writes Employee stamped onto createdBy when the key creates a project. Success envelope (secret only on create): { "payload": { "key": { "id": "key-…", "prefix": "tk_live_8f2a", "scopes": ["projects.write"], "status": "active" }, "secretOnce": "tk_live_8f2a_<uuid>_<tail>" } } Store secretOnce in your secret manager. Tracopus will not show it again. Use the full string as the Bearer token — not the prefix alone. 2 · Create a project Base URL is your Tracopus API host (example: https://c5i.tracopus.com ). No SPA api-key query param is required for integration tokens. POST /api/v2/projects Copy curl -sS -X POST "$BASE/api/v2/projects" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer tk_live_SUFFIX_UUID_TAIL" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{ "name": "ERP project", "userTeamId": 101, "purchaseOrderId": 9001, "createdBy": 12, "summary": "Created from ERP sync", "status": "NEW", "type": "BILLABLE" }' Typical 200 envelope: { "payload": { "id": 44102, "name": "ERP project", "userTeamId": 101, "purchaseOrderId": 9001, "status": "NEW", "createdBy": 12 } } Project request body JSON object mapped from ProjectRequest / ProjectInfo . Dates are ISO-8601 date-times. Field Type Notes name required string Project display name. purchaseOrderId required number Existing PO on the same team. Projects hang off this contract. userTeamId required* number Must equal the key’s team. Omit to let the server inject it. Mismatch → 403. createdBy sent number Overwritten with the key’s serviceEmployeeId . summary optional string Short description. status optional string NEW , CREATED , ASSIGNED , INPROGRESS , COMPLETED , CLOSED . type / projectType optional string Delivery classification used by your org (e.g. billable vs internal). code optional string External/project code if you maintain one. owner optional number Employee id of the delivery owner. estStartTime optional datetime e.g. 2026-09-01T00:00:00 . estCompletionTime optional datetime Planned end. estHours optional number Estimated hours. currency optional string ISO currency if set on the project. location optional string Project location. clientNames optional string[] Client labels. watchers optional string[] Watcher identifiers as stored by Tracopus. accountName optional string Account label. priority / complexity optional string Org-defined values. Do not send a different userTeamId than the key’s team. Query ?userTeamId= on other endpoints is also locked to the key team. Scope catalog Production and sandbox keys share this catalog. There is no sandbox.read / sandbox.write . Scope Allows projects.read GET /api/v2/projects* projects.write POST / PUT / PATCH / DELETE /api/v2/projects* — required to create purchaseorders.read GET /api/v2/purchaseorder* purchaseorders.write Write purchase orders tasks.read / tasks.write /api/v2/task* employees.read GET /api/v2/employees* integrations.read GET /api/v2/integrations/center* Auth, headers, errors Header Create key (admin) Create project (integration) Authorization Bearer admin JWT Bearer tk_live_… or tk_test_… Content-Type application/json application/json Uid Admin employee id Not required Current-User-Team-Id Admin team Not required Status Meaning 200 Created. Project is under payload . 401 / empty auth Missing Bearer, invalid secret, or API-key auth disabled on the server. 403 Missing projects.write , team mismatch, or developer-portal path called with an integration key. Body: {"error":[{"message":"Integration API key scope or team access denied"}]} or userTeamId must match integration key team . Curl builder Fill your values, generate, copy. Nothing is sent from this page. API base Integration secret Team id Purchase order id Created by (employee id) Project name Generated curl Generate Copy Tracopus integration API · project create. Token format tk_{live|test}_{suffix}_{uuid}_{tail} . Flag FS_INTEGRATION_API_KEY_AUTH_ENABLED . Open this file locally — no backend required.

pages.content: FAQ — Tracopus User Guide Home → FAQ 🔍 Jump to 📚 Documentation &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; screen guides 🎯 Scenario user guide 🔐 Login &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; account access 🧭 Navigation &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; Luxury UI 🏠 Workspace, tasks &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; approvals 👥 HRMS &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; employee records 🌴 Leave management 📍 Attendance &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; presence ⏱ Timesheet &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; time entry ✅ Timesheet approval &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; locking 📜 Audit trail &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; activity history 👔 People ops &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; lifecycle 📁 Projects &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; delivery 💼 Sales, bids &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; purchase orders 🧾 Invoices &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; billing 💰 Payroll &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; compensation 📈 Resource intelligence &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; staffing ⭐ Performance &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; goals 📱 Mobile app 📊 Charts &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; analytics 🔗 Integrations &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; data exchange 🛡 Admin, roles &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; security 🔧 Troubleshooting 🔑 App config · Access &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; getting started 🏢 App config · Organization tree &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; inheritance 💾 App config · Saving &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; filters 📋 App config · Application config (org.json data) 🔐 App config · Roles &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; access control ⏱ App config · Timesheet &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; work item rules 🔧 App config · Troubleshooting 273 questions · type to filter No matching questions — try different keywords. 📚 Documentation &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; screen guides 10 questions Where is the main Tracopus documentation? Open Documentation at /doucuments/index.html — screen-by-screen guides for HRMS, Project, Sales, Mobile, Charts, and Admin. What is the difference between screen docs and the Scenario Guide? Screen docs describe each UI screen (fields, charts, permissions). The Scenario Guide walks through end-to-end workflows (Feature → Scenario → Steps) for testers and end users. How do I find documentation for a specific screen? Use the header module mega-menu, home page module cards, or global search ( Ctrl + K ). Each screen doc includes breadcrumbs back to its module index. Where is Getting Started? getting-started.html — first-day orientation: login, navigation, Luxury UI, and links to HRMS, Project, and Sales modules. Where is the chart type reference? charts.html explains donut, bar, area, line, funnel, and treemap patterns used in summary strips and dashboards. How do I open Application Configuration documentation? HRMS → Application Config in docs ( hrms/application-config.html ) plus linked config FAQ sections at the bottom of this page. Are documentation pages updated with the app? Docs are static HTML in the repo — version query strings on CSS/JS ( ?v=… ) bust cache after releases. Hard-refresh if styles look stale. Can I link directly to a section in a screen doc? Yes — copy the URL with the heading anchor (e.g. hrms/timesheet.html#weekly-grid ). Breadcrumb and sidebar help you navigate back. Who maintains the documentation? Your workspace administrator or internal product team. Report gaps with the screen URL and expected behavior. Is there a printable or offline copy? Use the browser print dialog on any page. For bulk export, clone the doucuments/ folder from your deployment package. 🎯 Scenario user guide 10 questions Where is the Scenario User Guide? /doucuments/user-guide/index.html — 65 scenarios across 15 modules with step-by-step instructions. How is a scenario page structured? Each scenario shows roles , prerequisites , numbered steps , outcome , tips, and links to related scenarios and screen docs. What extra detail do enriched scenarios include? Permissions tables, org/feature flags, warnings, role-specific behavior notes, and a QA verify checklist — useful for testers and trainers. How do I find a scenario for my task? Browse by module index, open All scenarios , or search from the scenario home. Scenarios are grouped by feature (Login, Timesheet, Bid Requests, etc.). Can I use scenarios for UAT test cases? Yes — copy the verify checklist and steps into your test plan. Link the scenario URL as traceability to requirements. Why does a scenario mention a permission I do not have? Scenarios document all supported roles. Your effective permissions come from Application Configuration role templates on your org unit. How do scenarios link to screen documentation? Related links at the bottom point to matching screen guides (e.g. timesheet scenario → hrms/timesheet.html ). How often are scenarios updated? When new modules or workflows ship. Regenerate pages with node user-guide/generate-pages.js after editing scenarios-data.js . Is the Scenario Guide different from FAQ? FAQ answers short common questions. Scenarios are procedural walkthroughs for completing real tasks end-to-end. Mobile scenarios — where are they? Scenario Guide → Mobile App module covers QR login, PIN, timesheet, tasks, and insights on Android. 🔐 Login &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; account access 10 questions How do I sign in to Tracopus? Open your organization URL, enter username and password on the Luxury login screen, then click Sign In . SSO users click Sign in with Microsoft instead. What is Microsoft SSO? Single Sign-On redirects you to Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD). After corporate authentication you return to Tracopus already logged in — no separate password required. I forgot my password — what should I do? Click Forgot Password on the login page, submit your username or email, and follow the reset link. Contact your admin if mail does not arrive within 15 minutes. Why am I stuck on the login page after SSO? Your account may be inactive, not provisioned, or missing a default team. Ask your workspace administrator to verify employee status and role assignment. How do I activate a new employee account? Open the activation link from your welcome email ( /user/activateaccount/… ), set a password, then sign in. Links expire — request a new invite from HR if needed. Can I stay signed in on my laptop? Yes — sessions persist in the browser. Always sign out on shared machines via the header account menu. Why does my session expire? Security policy may enforce idle timeout or daily re-auth. SSO tenants often require re-login after token expiry — sign in again normally. What landing page do I see after login? Your default module dashboard (Project, HRMS, or Sales) depends on role permissions configured by your administrator. How do I change my password? Account menu → Profile → Security, or use the forced change link at /user/changepassword/… when prompted. SSO user — why is password change hidden? Credentials are managed by your identity provider. Use Microsoft account settings or IT helpdesk for password resets. 🧭 Navigation &amp;amp;amp;amp;amp;amp; Luxury UI 10 questions Where is the main module menu? The left sidebar lists HRMS, Sales, and Project modules. Expand each to see permitted screens for your role. What is the icon rail? The narrow vertical rail on the left edge provides quick links: Search, Taskboard, Calendar, Notes, Chat, Files, theme palette, and settings. How do I change the color theme? Click the palette droplet on the icon rail and pick a Luxury palette (Emerald, Indigo, Sapphire, etc.). Choice syncs to mobile after login. What does SHOW / SORT / Filter mean? Standard list header controls: SHOW = status presets, SORT = column order, Filter = text search on the register below. What is the summary strip? Collapsible KPI and chart row at the top of many list screens. Expand for analytics; collapse for a wider data table. How does global search work? Header search (or icon rail Search) finds projects, tasks, employees, and more. Results respect your team scope and permissions. Why is a sidebar item missing? Your role

pages.description: Getting Started — Tracopus user guide for enterprise work intelligence.
headings: I forgot my password — what now?
Why don't I see all sidebar modules?
What's the difference between deliverable and work item?
Can I use Tracopus on my phone?
pages.content: Getting Started — Tracopus User Guide Home → Getting Started Chapter 1 Getting Started Sign in, understand the workspace layout, and learn the building blocks — projects, deliverables, work items, and timesheets — before diving into module-specific guides. Login & authentication Open the application URL provided by your administrator. You land on the Luxury login screen with brand panel on the left and credentials on the right. 1. Enter username and password Use the credentials issued by your organization. Click the eye icon to reveal your password while typing. 2. Click Sign In On success you are redirected to your default module dashboard based on permissions — Project, HRMS, or Sales. 3. Session stays active Your session persists in the browser. Use Sign out from the header account menu when leaving a shared computer. ⚠️ Shared computers Always use Sign out from the header account menu when leaving a shared workstation. Sessions persist in the browser by default. 💡 Default landing page After login you land on your role's default module — Project Dashboard, HRMS Dashboard, or Sales list. Bookmark your most-used screen from the sidebar. Microsoft Single Sign-On (SSO) When enabled, click Sign in with Microsoft on the login page. You are redirected to Microsoft, authenticate, grant consent if prompted, and return logged in automatically. 📝 SSO availability SSO is controlled by your organization. If you do not see the Microsoft button, use standard login or contact your admin. Forgot password Click Forgot Password on the login page. Enter your username or email and submit. Check your inbox for reset instructions and follow the link. Set a new password on the change-password screen. Account activation New employees receive an activation link ( /user/activateaccount/… ). Open it, set your initial password, then sign in normally. The same flow applies to forced password changes via /user/changepassword/… . Navigation overview The Luxury shell has three navigation zones: Left sidebar Module directories — HRMS, Sales, Project — each expanding to show permitted pages. Icon rail Quick links: Search, Taskboard, Calendar, Notes, Chat, Files, theme, settings, today activity. Top header Module kicker, page title, global search, tasks/chat/notifications dropdowns, account menu. See the Luxury Interface guide for full detail on search, palettes, and mobile shortcuts. Core concepts Term Meaning Project A delivery container with account, team, estimates, status, and members. Links optionally to purchase orders and bids. Deliverable A task-level outcome within a project (also called a task in some views). Has status, estimates, assignees, and work items underneath. Work item Granular unit of work and time logging tied to a deliverable — billable or non-billable activities. Account Client or organizational node in the directory — may represent accounts, teams, or clients in a hierarchy. Timesheet Weekly grid of recorded hours (billable, non-billable, leave) submitted per employee. Bid request Sales pipeline record tracking study/commercial bids from intake through won or lost. Purchase order Contract linked to delivery — may connect to bids and spawn projects. Team Organizational scope used for filtering lists, reports, and dashboards. Bid (Sales) → Purchase Order → Project → Deliverable → Work item → Timesheet Recommended first steps 1. Check your HRMS dashboard Review attendance strip, utilization donut, and task queue mix for the current week. 2. Open the Taskboard See your assigned deliverables in Planned → To do → In progress → Done columns. 3. Log time in Timesheet Navigate to HRMS → Time Sheet, pick the week, and add billable or non-billable entries. 4. Register mobile (optional) From mobile User Login, scan the QR code after web authentication to enable PIN/biometric access. 5. Personalize your theme Click the palette droplet on the icon rail and pick a color mood that suits you — it syncs to mobile. Frequently asked questions I forgot my password — what now? Use Forgot Password on the login page. If email does not arrive, check spam or contact your admin — SSO users may not use local passwords. Why don't I see all sidebar modules? Modules and pages are permission-gated. HRMS Employees, Sales, and Admin settings appear only when your role includes those scopes. What's the difference between deliverable and work item? A deliverable is a planned outcome within a project (milestone/task). Work items are granular activities underneath — where most time is logged on the timesheet. Can I use Tracopus on my phone? Yes — see Mobile overview . Register your device after web login via QR code for PIN or biometric access. ℹ️ Need deeper detail? Each screen in HRMS, Sales, Project, and Mobile has a dedicated guide with charts, features, permissions, and common mistakes — open the module index from the top navigation. Scenario user guide When you need to complete a task (not just understand a screen), open the Scenario User Guide . It documents 65 workflows across 15 modules with: Required permissions — RBAC config paths your admin must enable Org & feature flags — behavior when Application Config toggles are on or off Warnings & considerations — common failures and planning notes Numbered steps and a QA verification checklist per scenario Sign in Email/password login scenario Log timesheet Weekly hour entry Approvals inbox Approve timesheet, leave, attendance All 65 scenarios Complete workflow index Your profile Open the account menu (avatar) in the header → Profile to view your employee record, skills, security settings, notifications, and account activity. Managers can open any employee from HRMS → Employees. Settings (gear on icon rail or account menu) covers organization preferences: mobile device registration, schedulers, service health, company info, localization, and notifications. Next: Luxury Interface → © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved. Documentation Scenario Guide Getting Started Charts For support, contact your workspace administrator.

pages.title: Attendance
pages.description: Month matrix for present / absent / leave, manager approvals, regularization requests, leave-to-attendance sync, and soft payroll lock (no matrix export).
pages.content: Attendance — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Attendance Interactive data flow Toggle attendance flags — mark, auto-approve, manager queue, regularization bridge, and leave sync. Primary simulator Attendance & regularization → All simulators Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step. Matching nodes highlight as the narration advances. flowchart TD A[Enable attendance role] --> B[Shift / holiday config] B --> C[Regularization policy optional] C --> D[Mark matrix] D --> E[Approve pending] E --> F[Soft payroll lock] 1 Enable attendance role Role flag attendanceEnabled + mark/approve permissions. 2 Shift / holiday config Optional shift policies and People holidays for correct day context. 3 Regularization policy Turn on when employees can request corrections; set soft payroll lock day when used. 4 Mark matrix Managers mark present/absent/leave per employee-day. 5 Approve pending Clear attendance and regularization queues. 6 Soft payroll lock May freeze prior-month edits / regularizations after the lock day — no matrix export in product today. flowchart TD O[Open Attendance] --> F[Filter team / employee / month] F --> C[Click day cell] C --> M[Mark popover] M --> S{Status} S -->|Present / Absent / Half-day / Leave| Save[Save mark] Save --> Aud[Audit event] Save --> Pend{Needs approval?} Pend -->|Yes| Queue[Pending approvals] Pend -->|No| Done[Visible on matrix] 1 Open Attendance HRMS → Attendance with team access. 2 Filter Narrow team, employee, and month before marking. 3 Click day cell Open mark or details popover for that employee-day. 4 Mark popover Choose status and save. 5 Status Present, absent, half-day, leave, etc. per org options. 6 Save mark Persists the attendance record. 7 Audit event Who changed what is recorded when audit is on. 8 Needs approval? Some orgs route marks to a pending queue. 9 Pending approvals Manager decides later. 10 Visible on matrix Cell color updates immediately when no approval needed. flowchart TD Emp[Employee or manager] --> Reg[Submit regularization] Reg --> Pol{Policy / payroll lock OK?} Pol -->|No| Block[Blocked with reason] Pol -->|Yes| Sub[SUBMITTED] Sub --> Mgr[Manager / delegate decides] Mgr -->|Approve| Upd[Attendance updated] Mgr -->|Reject| Rel[Rejected + comment] 1 Requester Employee (self-service) or manager on their behalf. 2 Submit regularization Pick date, reason, and requested status. 3 Policy / lock check Fails closed if outside policy or past payroll lock. 4 Blocked User sees why the request cannot proceed. 5 SUBMITTED Enters pending regularization queue. 6 Manager decides Approve or reject with comment. 7 Attendance updated Matrix reflects the approved correction. 8 Rejected No matrix change; requester notified. flowchart TD L[Leave approved] --> Flag{leaveAutoSyncToAttendance?} Flag -->|Yes| Sync[Write LEAVE / HALF_DAY] Sync --> Mat[Shows on Attendance matrix] Flag -->|No| Manual[Manual mark or leave overlay only] 1 Leave approved Manager approves a leave request. 2 Sync flag? Org leaveAdditional.leaveAutoSyncToAttendance. 3 Write LEAVE / HALF_DAY Attendance sync service updates working days in range. 4 Shows on matrix Cells display leave without manual mark. 5 Manual path If flag off, mark leave cells yourself or rely on overlay only. flowchart TD P[Pending panel or Approvals inbox] --> Rev[Review employee-day] Rev --> Dec{Decision} Dec -->|Approve| Acc[Accept mark / regularization] Acc --> Mat[Matrix updated] Dec -->|Reject| Com[Reject + comment] 1 Open pending Attendance page pending section or Approvals inbox. 2 Review Check employee, date, requested status, and reason. 3 Decision Approve or reject. 4 Accept Mark or regularization becomes final. 5 Matrix updated Cell reflects the approved status. 6 Reject + comment No change to attendance; requester notified. Overview HRMS → Attendance is the month-at-a-glance control surface for who was present, absent, on leave, or needs correction. Managers mark cells, approve pending items, and (when enabled) process regularization. Approved leave can auto-write attendance when leaveAutoSyncToAttendance is on. Screen layout Header — team scope, employee filter, Documentation link, month navigation via summary. Summary strip — attendance rate and absence KPIs for the filtered month. Pending approvals — attendance marks / regularizations awaiting decision. Matrix — employees × days; color-coded cells; click to mark or view details. Current-user panel — your own pattern when viewing self. Payroll lock banner — soft lock when prior-month edits are frozen (no matrix export). Flags & prerequisites Role: hrmsModules.attendanceEnabled + attendance CRUD as needed. Org: attendanceAdditional.attendanceRegularizationEnabled for regularization flows. Org: leaveAdditional.leaveAutoSyncToAttendance for leave → attendance writes. Optional: shift policies ( /admin/shift-policies ), holidays ( Leave Configuration → Holidays ), delegation for approvers away. Permissions Role Access Employee Often view self / submit regularization when enabled; personal strip also on Dashboard. Manager Mark and approve for managed teams; pending panel. HR / Payroll Full matrix, policy, and soft payroll lock where configured. Related pages Leave Management Apply/approve leave; can sync into attendance. Leave Configuration Holidays and leaveAutoSyncToAttendance flag. Timesheet Leave hours should align with matrix leave markers. Scenario: Mark attendance Step-by-step mark flow. pages.title: Unified Audit Trail
pages.description: A single luxury timeline for meaningful actions — who did what, when, and on which record — across projects, HR, and profile activity.
pages.content: Unified Audit Trail — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Unified Audit Trail Overview The unified audit system records events when users (or delegates) perform tracked actions. Events appear in Audit tabs on project, purchase contract, deliverable, work item, profile, attendance, timesheet, and leave screens. Legacy @History and ItemAdditional HISTORY feeds are not shown in the new UI. History starts from go-live when your administrator enables audit writes. Where to find audit Profile → Account activity — actor timeline + entity filter Project / PO / Deliverable — Comments | Audit tabs Work item — activity register audit mode Attendance — audit feed with deep links to day cells Timesheet week — submit/approve/lock events Leave drawer — request lifecycle with redaction What is tracked Project, PO, deliverable, work item lifecycle Comments, checklist updates, estimates Employee profile and role changes Attendance mark, approve, reject, removal Leave submit, approve, reject, withdraw Timesheet submit, approve, reject, lock Login and password change (security) Timeline UI Each event shows headline , actor , timestamp , action chip (Approved, Submitted, etc.), and optional metadata (status change, acting-for manager, approval comment). Pagination uses server-side pageInfo.hasMore — use prev/next at the bottom of the trail. Delegate actions display Acting for {name} when metadata includes acting-for fields. Access & privacy Scope Who can view Actor timeline Self, direct manager, or approval delegate (attendance/timesheet/leave). Employee / HR entity Same rules on the subject employee. Project / PO / deliverable Users on the same org team as the resource. Leave metadata Reason and remarks redacted for non-self viewers. What's new ✓ Luxury timeline Shared AuditTrailSection component across modules. ✓ Actor + entity queries Filter profile activity by entity type (attendance, leave, etc.). ✓ Attendance deep links Jump from audit event to attendance detail popover. ✓ CSV export Compliance export with same permission checks (admin). ✓ Fail-safe writes Audit DB errors never fail leave approve, timesheet submit, or project save. ✓ Dedup Duplicate events suppressed via natural key — safe retries. Administrator setup ℹ️ Enable writes Set auditEnabled: true per org after DB migration. UI can show with auditUiEnabled: true (default). 💡 Empty timeline? Events appear only after enablement — perform a tracked action to verify. Related pages Employee Profile Account activity actor timeline. Project Details Activity tab Audit panel. Leave Management Leave audit drawer. Timesheet Approval Week workflow events. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

Appears on Leave pending + Approvals inbox. 3a Approve APPROVED; debit (releases hold); promote TaskActivity LEAVE; attendance LEAVE / HALF_DAY when sync on. 3b Reject REJECTED; release hold; no TaskActivity / attendance write. Comment required. 4 Withdraw (owner) CREATED or SUBMITTED → WITHDRAWN; release hold if submitted. Blocked on APPROVED / SYNCED. 5 Cancel (owner) SUBMITTED / APPROVED / SYNCED → CANCELLED; release hold or creditOnCancelAfterApprove; demote TaskActivity; reverse attendance. Core scenarios (LS1–LS12) LS1 Create → Submit → Approve Pass Happy path: balance debit, promote, pending cleared. Actors Employee → Manager Assert APPROVED; debitOnApprove; promote; audit APPROVE JUnit ls1_approve_promotesAndDebitsBalance Watch Approvals inbox + attendance LEAVE cell (Playwright) LS2 Create → Submit → Reject Pass Reject releases pending; no promote / debit. Actors Employee → Manager JUnit ls2_reject_releasesPendingBalance LS3 Create → Withdraw Pass Owner withdraws draft; never pending. JUnit ls3_withdraw_draft_setsWithdrawn LS4 Submit → Withdraw Pass Owner withdraws submitted; hold released. JUnit ls4_withdraw_submitted_releasesHold LS5 Submit → Cancel Pass Owner cancels submitted; hold released; no approve-debit reverse. JUnit ls5_cancel_submitted_releasesHold LS6 Approve → Cancel Pass Owner cancel after approve credits debit and re-runs promote (demote path). JUnit ls6_cancel_afterApprove_creditsDebit LS7 Re-apply after terminal Pass Overlap ignores REJECTED / WITHDRAWN / CANCELLED; second leave can approve. Code LeaveOverlapService terminal filter JUnit ls7_overlap_ignoresTerminalStatuses LS8 Overlap block Pass Second active overlap blocked; first untouched. JUnit ls8_submit_blockedWhenOverlap LS9 Holiday / weekly-off day count Pass Create/submit resolve day count via holiday validation; non-working-only range blocked. JUnit ls9_submit_blockedWhenOnlyNonWorkingDays + day-count resolve on create/submit LS9b Half-day leave apply → approve Pass Half-day flag persisted on single-day create; multi-day request clears half-day. JUnit ls9b_create_halfDay_persistsOnSingleDay Watch Attendance HALF_DAY cell when sync on (integration) LS10 Insufficient balance Pass Submit blocked; no orphan reserve. JUnit ls10_submit_blockedWhenInsufficientBalance LS11 Illegal transitions Pass 4xx; status unchanged — withdraw on APPROVED, cancel on CREATED, approve without authority. JUnit ls11_* family LS12 Stale expectedStatus Pass Concurrent safe conflict on approve. JUnit ls12_approve_staleExpectedStatusReturnsConflict Cancel family (LS6b–d) LS6b SYNCED → Cancel Pass Same reverse as approved (credit + promote demote). JUnit ls6b_cancel_synced_creditsDebit LS6c Cancel vs Withdraw rules Pass Withdraw blocked on APPROVED/SYNCED; cancel blocked on CREATED/REJECTED/WITHDRAWN/CANCELLED. JUnit ls6c_* LS6d Non-owner cancel / withdraw Pass Manager/delegate forbidden; manager uses reject. JUnit ls6d_nonOwner_cancelAndWithdrawForbidden Delegation / on-behalf / Zing LS-DEL-1 Delegate approves Pass LEAVE delegation → delegate approves; DELEGATE + actedOnBehalfOf audit. JUnit lsDel1_approve_allowedForDelegate Wave WA2 LS-DEL-2 Expired / revoked mid-pending Pass Delegate blocked; owner manager can still approve. JUnit lsDel2_* + ApprovalAuthorityServiceTest.lsDel2_* LS-DEL-3 Attendance auto ≠ leave auto Pass ATTENDANCE-only delegation / persona cannot leave-approve; no debit/promote. JUnit lsDel3_* + authority ATTENDANCE-only vs LEAVE LS-OB-1..2 On-behalf apply / sibling isolation Pass Manager create/submit for member (member balance); approve A leaves B SUBMITTED. JUnit lsOb1_* , lsOb2_* FE buildLeaveCreatePayload(..., actorId) current user as actor LS-ZING-1 ZingHR SYNCED coexistence Pass Native leave with zinghrTransactionId + SYNCED; cancel credits balance + promote demote. pages.content: Leave Configuration — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Leave Configuration One-stop leave guide End-to-end configure → dry-run balances → schedulers → apply/approve, plus a Data Flow & Technical Debug tab — single HTML for HR and support. Start here Open Leave One-Stop Guide → Policies catalogue Leave Policies User Guide → Configure How to configure policies → Leave Management (runtime) Interactive data flow Trace GLP publish, balance ledger, accrual schedulers, and working-day resolver chain used before employees apply leave. Primary simulator Leave policy & accrual → Working days Shift + holidays WDR → All simulators Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step. Matching nodes highlight as the narration advances. flowchart TD A[Enable flags] --> B[Publish policy] B --> C[Holidays and working days] C --> D[Balances / jurisdiction] D --> E[Employee applies] E --> F[Manager approves] F --> G[Attendance and timesheet] 1 Enable flags Turn on leaveManagementEnabled (and Global Leave role modules) in Application Config. 2 Publish policy Jurisdiction → template → draft → simulate → publish in Global Policy Center. 3 Holidays and working days Assign holiday calendar keys and weekly-off rules (team / country / employee). 4 Balances / jurisdiction Employee leave config: OB template → dry-run import or Adjust balance; assign jurisdictions when needed. 5 Employee applies Leave Management apply drawer with resolved day count. 6 Manager approves Pending panel or Approvals inbox. 7 Attendance and timesheet Promotion + optional leave→attendance sync. flowchart TD F1[1. App Config flags] --> F2[2. Create jurisdiction] F2 --> F3[3. Template to draft policy] F3 --> F4[4. Simulate / Policy Test Lab] F4 --> F5[5. Publish version] F5 --> F6[6. People holidays + calendar key] F6 --> F7[7. Working-day rules] F7 --> F8[8. Opening balances or accrual] F8 --> F9[9. Prove apply and approve] 1 App Config flags Org leaveAdditional + role leave/admin modules. 2 Create jurisdiction e.g. IN, IN-KA, AE — used for resolve and calendars. 3 Template → draft Apply country baseline; edit entitlements/accrual. 4 Simulate / Test Lab Dry-run for a sample employee; pass publish gates. 5 Publish version Activates accrual and eligibility. 6 Holidays + key People holidays with location keys assigned to jurisdictions. 7 Working-day rules Team default and/or country patterns; employee assigns. 8 Balances Admin → Employee leave config: Download OB template → fill → dry-run → live, or Adjust balance per employee. 9 Prove Apply leave spanning holiday/weekly off → approve → check timesheet. flowchart TD J[Jurisdiction] --> T[Template] T --> D[Draft version] D --> S[Simulate] S --> P[Publish] P --> R[Accrual and eligibility] 1 Jurisdiction Country/region dimension for the policy. 2 Template Seed draft from a national/regional baseline. 3 Draft version Edit types, accrual, carry-forward while unpublished. 4 Simulate Preview resolve for an employee before publish. 5 Publish Locks the version for runtime use. 6 Accrual and eligibility Jobs and leave apply use the published rules. flowchart TD L[Leave create or submit] --> R[LeaveWorkingDayResolver] R --> O{Employee WDR override?} O -->|Yes| P[Resolved workdays] O -->|No| J{Employee jurisdiction?} J -->|Yes| JW[Jurisdiction / country WDR] JW --> P J -->|No| TW[Team-default WDR] TW -->|Hit| P TW -->|Miss| FB[Work schedule / shift / Mon-Fri] FB --> P 1 Leave create/submit Day count always re-resolved with employeeId. 2 Resolver Shared service for leave UI, validate, promote. 3 Employee override? Personal WDR assignment — highest priority. 4 Resolved workdays Final ISO weekday set used for counting. 5 Employee jurisdiction? Assigned leave jurisdiction (country/region). 6 Jurisdiction WDR e.g. AE Sun–Thu or IN Mon–Fri. 7 Team-default WDR Rule with no jurisdiction_id. 8 Hit Use team rule workdays. 9 Fallback Work schedule → shift → Mon–Fri default. flowchart TD AP[Published policy] --> AJ[Accrual job] AJ --> BL1[Balance ledger credit] HR[HR adjust / import] --> BL2[Balance ledger] BL1 --> UI[Visible on Leave Management] BL2 --> UI 1 Published policy Entitlements/accrual rules must be live. 2 Accrual job Scheduler credits by period (idempotent). 3 Ledger credit Available balance increases. 4 HR adjust / import Employee leave config: single Adjust balance, or CSV template + dry-run import API. 5 Balance ledger Same ledger used by apply/approve. 6 Visible on Leave Management Balance cards refresh for the employee. flowchart TD A[Apply] --> V[Overlap + working days] V --> S[Submit / reserve] S --> D{Approve or Reject?} D -->|Approve| B[Debit balance] B --> P[Promote TaskActivity] P --> T[Attendance sync if flagged] D -->|Reject| Rel[Release pending + comment] 1 Apply Employee creates the leave request. 2 Validate Overlap + working-day rules + day count. 3 Submit / reserve Pending balance held. 4 Decision Approve or reject. 5 Debit Used balance increases on approve. 6 Promote Timesheet leave activities. 7 Attendance sync Optional LEAVE / HALF_DAY marks. 8 Reject path Comment required; pending released. Overview Leave has two halves: configure once (this page) and use every day ( Leave Management ). Complete the configuration layers below before asking employees to apply. Org & role flags — turn the module on in Application Config. Global Policy Center (preferred) — jurisdictions, templates, versioned policies, publish, simulate. Classic leave policies (fallback) — type catalog and simple entitlements when Global Leave is off. Holidays & legal calendars — People holidays + calendar key assignments. Working days — team / country / employee weekly-off patterns (not hard-coded Sat/Sun). Employee leave config — opening balances / adjustments, OB template download, dry-run bulk import; optional employee jurisdiction assign. pages.content: Leave Management — One-Stop Guide — Tracopus Home → HRMS → Leave Management One-Stop Guide User Guide — Configure & Use Data Flow & Technical Debug Tip: use the chips above to jump. Printing this page includes both tabs. 1. How to open leave for the first time ℹ️ Two doors Employees / managers use People → Leave management ( /people/leaves ). HR admins configure first under Admin → Leave admin and Admin → Employee leave config . If the menu is missing, flags or role modules are off (see §3). Employee / manager path Sign in Use an account on a team where leave is enabled. Open People → Leave management Direct URL: /people/leaves (legacy /hrms/leaves redirects here). Confirm balances appear Balance cards show PL/CL/SL (and specials). Empty cards usually mean opening balances were never imported and accrual has not run yet — not a UI bug. Apply Use Apply leave / create drawer: pick type, dates, half-day if needed, notes/docs, then submit. Admin first-time path (before anyone applies) Application Config — turn on org + role leave flags (§3). Global Policy Center — publish a policy (§4–5). Holidays + working-day rules (§8). Employee leave config — dry-run OB import, then live (§9–10). Enable schedulers ACCRUAL / CF / COMP_OFF_EXPIRE (§11). Prove apply → approve on a test employee (§12–13). 2. Big picture — configure then use flowchart LR A[App Config flags] --> B[Publish policy] B --> C[Holidays + working days] C --> D[Opening balances / accrual] D --> E[Employee applies] E --> F[Manager / delegate approves] F --> G[Balance debit + timesheet + attendance] 💡 Publishing ≠ balances Publishing a policy activates eligibility and accrual rules. Tracopus does not invent opening balances. HR must import (or Adjust) balances, or wait for the monthly accrual job after go-live. 3. What must be configured (flags) Path: Admin → Application configuration → select the org unit / team → HRMS / Modules / role templates. Org flags ( leaveAdditional ) Flag Purpose Typical go-live leaveManagementEnabled Master switch — APIs and jobs fail closed when off Required globalLeavePoliciesEnabled Global Policy Center runtime Required (preferred) leaveEnhancementsEnabled Extended leave UX (impact drawer, etc.) Optional leaveAutoSyncToAttendance Approved leave → attendance LEAVE / HALF_DAY Usually on leaveBlockNonWorkingDayLeave Reject ranges with no working days Usually on leaveBlockOverlapRegardlessOfType Reject overlapping leave dates Usually on leaveAllowNegativeBalance Allow submit below available balance Usually off approvalDelegation.approvalDelegationEnabled Delegates can approve leave As needed Role modules peopleModules.leavesEnabled — shows People → Leave management peopleModules.holidaysEnabled — People → Holidays adminModules.leavePoliciesEnabled — classic policies + Employee leave config adminModules.globalLeavePoliciesEnabled — Global Policy Center, Test Lab, legal calendars, working-day rules Manager: approveTeamEnabled — required for approve actions Optional: universalApprovalInboxEnabled — leave in /workspace/approvals Menu rule: UI needs org leaveManagementEnabled and role peopleModules.leavesEnabled . APIs gate on the org flag only. 4. What to update — admin screen map What you update Where Route Type entitlements, accrual, CF, specials Global Policy Center → policy version /admin/leave/global-policy-center Leave type catalog (classic fallback) Leave policies /admin/leave-policies Per-employee balances / OB import Employee leave config /admin/employee-leave-config Official holidays Legal calendars + People holidays /admin/leave/legal-calendars , /people/holidays Weekly offs Working day rules /admin/leave/working-day-rules Pre-publish dry-run scenarios Policy Test Lab / Simulator /admin/leave/policy-test-lab Approval coverage when manager away Delegation /admin/delegation Org / role flags Application Config /admin/application-config 5. How to create / publish a new leave policy Primary console: Admin → Leave admin → Global Policy Center . Create or select a jurisdiction Examples: IN , IN-KA , IN-MH , AE . Used for resolve, holiday calendars, and working-day scope. Apply a country / CFA template into a draft Choose CFA-IN-KA , CFA-IN-MH , CFA-IN-HR , CFA-IN-TN-CBE , or a blank draft. Edit entitlements, accrual, carry-forward, and special-leave JSON while unpublished. Simulate / Policy Test Lab Dry-run resolve for a sample employee. Lab scenarios may gate publish. Open /admin/leave/policy-test-lab . Assign holiday calendar key Key must match People → Holidays location keys (e.g. IN-KA ). Configure working-day rules Team default, jurisdiction pattern (e.g. Mon–Fri or Sun–Thu), or employee override. Publish the version Published versions are immutable . To change rules later, clone a new draft and publish again. Publish activates accrual eligibility — it does not create balances. flowchart TD J[Jurisdiction] --> T[Apply template] T --> D[Edit draft version] D --> S[Simulate / Test Lab] S --> H[Holiday key + WDR] H --> P[Publish] P --> R[Accrual + eligibility live] APIs (for automation / support): jurisdictions POST /api/v2/leave/global/jurisdictions · apply template POST /api/v2/leave/global/templates/{id}/apply · simulate POST /api/v2/leave/global/simulate · publish POST /api/v2/leave/global/versions/{versionId}/publish . 6. Supported leave policies — how each is configured PL means Privilege Leave (earned) — not paternity. Paternity is PATERNITY . Code Name How to configure Key runtime rules Status PL Privilege Leave GLP version entitlements + monthly accrual; CF max in rules Fiscal Apr–Mar; CF max 45 ; excess LAPSE (or ENCASH if re-published) Shipped CL Casual Leave Location pack entitlements (MH/HR/TN); no CF Lapses at fiscal year end; not in KA pack Shipped SL Sick Leave Location pack (KA/HR/TN); document rules for medical proof Medical certificate when ≥3 days; no CF Shipped MATERNITY Maternity specialLeave[] in published GLP; FE child # maps days Female; min 80 service days; 182/182/84/84; proof; auto end from start Shipped PATERNITY Paternity Special leave rules in GLP Male; 5 consecutive days; window 7 days before or 45 after event Shipped MSL Milestone Leave Tenure grant rules in GLP Grant at 5/10/15/20y; 5-day block; partial use forfeits remainder Shipped WWL Wellness Leave KA female special in CFA-IN-KA 1 day/month; ±3 day apply window; lapses last working day of month Shipped COMPOFF Compensatory Off Comp-off policy + attendance credit coupling Weekend/statutory ≥6h or weekday >15h; expire 90 days Shipped FLOATING Floating Holiday Floating catalogue + calendar-year budget Employee picks published option; Jan renew credits entitlement Shipped UNPAID / UL Unpaid / LOP Catalog type; LOP coupling where enabled No entitlement balance required in typical setups Shipped ADOPTION / MISCARRIAGE Special stubs Catalog only until HR confirms days Entitlement days TBD Stub Always needs approval Leave requests always go through approval — even when attendance auto-approves for some bands. Two leave years Earned leave uses fiscal Apr–Mar . Floating holiday budget uses calendar Jan–Dec . Server trusts day count Create/submit recalculate numberOfDays from working week + holidays. Half-day = 0.5. Classic fallback If Global Leave is off, use /admin/leave-policies type catalog; accrual falls back to classic policy. 7. CFA India location packs (defaults) Production prefill: migration 09-cfa-leave-india-production-prefill.sql . Resolve uses employee work location / jurisdiction. Pack Location PL CL SL Notes CFA-IN-KA Karnataka (Bengaluru) 18 — 12 WWL (female KA); +1 mandatory PH vs other states CFA-IN-MH Maharashtra (Mumbai) 18 7 — Specials + COMPOFF + FLOATING CFA-IN-HR Haryana (Gurugram) 18 8 8 Specials + COMPOFF + FLOATING CFA-IN-TN-CBE Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore) 12 12 12 Lower PL vs other India packs Shared: MATERNITY / PATERNITY / MSL / COMPOFF / FLOATING; PL CF max 45 with excess LAPSE by default. 8. pages.content: Leave Policies User Guide — Tracopus Documentation Home → HRMS → Leave Policies Guide Overview Supported policies India packs How to configure Scenarios New vs existing Admin screens Checklist What this guide covers Tracopus leave has two layers: Policy configuration — jurisdictions, country templates, versioned team policies, holidays, working days, publish (this guide + Leave Configuration ). Day-to-day runtime — employees apply on People → Leave management ; managers approve there or in Workspace → Approvals. Shipped — India CFA packs Shipped — apply / approve / accrual / CF Partial — AE / SA / US stubs Planned — adoption days TBD ℹ️ Publishing ≠ balances Publishing a policy activates eligibility and accrual rules. Opening balances still come from Employee leave config (OB template → dry-run → live) or the accrual schedule — Tracopus does not invent balances. Domain principles Location-driven policy — entitlements differ by work location / jurisdiction (KA, MH, HR, TN-CBE, …). Two leave years — earned leave uses fiscal Apr–Mar ; floating holiday budget uses calendar Jan–Dec . Leave always needs approval — even when attendance auto-approves for some bands. Configurable, not hardcoded — rules live in Global Leave templates / published versions (not hard-coded Sat/Sun). Canonical sources only — Employee, leave types, balance ledger, holidays, TaskActivity promotion; no shadow leave tables. Quick path (first go-live) Flags — enable leaveManagementEnabled (+ Global Leave role modules) in Application Config. Publish policy — Global Policy Center: jurisdiction → apply CFA India template → simulate → publish (or use production prefill SQL for defaults). Holidays + working days — calendar keys + weekly-off rules. Balances — Employee leave config OB template / Adjust balance. Prove — apply spanning holiday → Approvals approve → check timesheet / attendance sync. Supported leave type catalogue Codes below are the production leave type codes used by CFA India packs and classic catalog. PL means Privilege Leave (earned) — not paternity. Code Name Category Key rules Status PL Privilege Leave Earned Fiscal year; monthly accrual; carry-forward max 45 ; excess LAPSE (or ENCASH if HR re-publishes). Shipped CL Casual Leave Casual Location packs (MH / HR / TN); no carry-forward; lapses at fiscal year end. Not in KA pack. Shipped SL Sick Leave Sick Location packs (KA / HR / TN); medical certificate when ≥3 days; no CF. Shipped MATERNITY Maternity Leave Special Female; min 80 service days; 182 / 182 / 84 / 84 by child #; max start 8 weeks before event; auto end from start; proof required. Shipped PATERNITY Paternity Leave Special Male; 5 consecutive days; window 7 days before or 45 days after event. Shipped MSL Milestone Leave Special Tenure grant at 5/10/15/20y (+ catch-up); 5-day block; partial use forfeits remainder. Shipped WWL Wellness Leave Special KA female; 1 day/month; ±3 day apply window; lapses last working day of month. Shipped COMPOFF Compensatory Off Comp-off Credit from eligible weekend/statutory (≥6h) or weekday (>15h); expire 90 days from work day; encash path staged. Shipped FLOATING Floating Holiday Holiday Calendar-year budget from PH catalogue; employee picks from published options; Jan renew credits entitlement. Shipped UL Unpaid / LOP Unpaid Catalog type for unpaid absence / LOP coupling where enabled. Shipped ADOPTION / MISCARRIAGE Special (catalog) Special Catalog stubs present; entitlement days still TBD with HR . Stub Platform capabilities (policy engine) Jurisdictions & templates Country / region dimensions; apply CFA baseline template into a draft team policy. Versioned publish Draft → simulate / Policy Test Lab → publish. Published versions are immutable. Accrual & carry-forward Schedules LEAVE_ACCRUAL , LEAVE_CARRY_FORWARD , COMP_OFF_EXPIRE . Working days & holidays Weekly-off rules + People holidays filtered by calendar key assignment. Half-day & day count Server recalculates numberOfDays ; excludes weekly offs and matched holidays. Documents & privacy Medical / maternity proof rules; MAT/PAT/WWL privacy masking on sensitive fields. Classic fallback /admin/leave-policies type catalog when Global Leave is off. Multi-country stubs AE / SA / US packs are scaffolded — entitlements still HR-confirm. CFA India location packs (production defaults) Prefill templates ( CFA-IN-* ) ship with production-migration 09-cfa-leave-india-production-prefill.sql . Resolve uses employee work location / region. Pack Location PL CL SL Special / notes CFA-IN-KA Karnataka (Bengaluru) 18 — 12 WWL (female KA); +1 mandatory PH vs other states CFA-IN-MH Maharashtra (Mumbai) 18 7 — Specials + COMPOFF + FLOATING CFA-IN-HR Haryana (Gurugram) 18 8 8 Specials + COMPOFF + FLOATING CFA-IN-TN-CBE Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore) 12 12 12 Lower PL vs other India packs Shared across packs: MATERNITY / PATERNITY / MSL / COMPOFF / FLOATING; fiscal Apr–Mar for earned leave; PL CF max 45 with excess LAPSE by default; PH budget 11 calendar-year floating remainder. Shared special / holiday rules Maternity — 182 days (1st/2nd child), 84 days (3rd+); start ≤8 weeks before expected delivery; FE maps child # to days. Paternity — exactly 5 consecutive days inside apply window. Comp-off — weekend/statutory ≥6h or weekday >15h; 90-day use-or-expire from work day. Floating — pick from published catalogue; reject if catalogue / budget missing. MSL — tenure months 60 / 120 / 180 / 240; catch-up window supported. How to configure leave policies Primary console: Admin → Leave admin → Global Policy Center ( /admin/leave/global-policy-center ). Requires leaveAdditional.globalLeavePoliciesEnabled and adminModules.globalLeavePoliciesEnabled . Enable flags Application Config → org leaveAdditional.leaveManagementEnabled (+ Global Leave / leavePolicies role modules). Minimal flag flips only — do not invent full App Config for NULL-config teams. Create or select a jurisdiction e.g. IN , IN-KA , IN-MH . Used for resolve, holiday calendars, and working-day scope. Apply a country / CFA template into a draft Choose CFA-IN-KA (etc.) or blank draft. Edit type entitlements, accrual, carry-forward, special leave JSON as needed. Simulate / Policy Test Lab Dry-run a sample employee. Lab may gate publish. Guide: Policy Test Lab . Assign holiday calendar key Key must match People → Holidays locations (e.g. IN-KA ). Optionally publish Legal Calendars first. Working-day rules /admin/leave/working-day-rules — team default, jurisdiction pattern, or employee override. “Country” means leave jurisdiction assignment. Publish version Activates accrual / eligibility. Published versions are immutable — clone a new draft to change. Opening balances Employee leave config : Download OB template → fill from ZingHR → dry-run import → live; or Adjust balance per employee. Prove apply → approve People → Leaves apply; Workspace → Approvals or pending panel approve; confirm day count, balance debit, timesheet promotion. What you configure where Concern Where Notes Type entitlements / accrual / CF Global Policy Center policy version Prefer templates; edit draft before publish Leave type catalog (classic) /admin/leave-policies Fallback when Global Leave off Per-employee balances /admin/employee-leave-config OB template + Adjust balance Holidays People → Holidays + Legal calendars Location keys must match assignment Weekly offs Working day rules Not hard-coded Sat/Sun Floating catalogue Policy / floating admin + apply drawer picker Expanded by production SQL 10 Schedules Scheduler jobs ACCRUAL / CF / COMP_OFF_EXPIRE Enabled via production SQL 11 Delegation /admin/delegation Leave in approval scopes Production cutover (ops) When defaults are locked by SQL prefill, HR still must: Confirm leaveManagementEnabled for real teams. Import opening balances (never invent rows). Smoke apply → approve on a flagged team. Runbooks: opening-balance import · cutover publish (internal fui/docs/leave/pending/ ). Configuration & runtime scenarios Scenario Actor

pages.title: Leave Management
pages.description: Apply for leave, track balances, submit for approval, and see manager decisions — with working-week and holiday aware day counts.
pages.content: Leave Management — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Leave Management One-stop leave guide Configuring leave for the first time? Use the one-stop guide (configure, dry-run, schedulers, approval + data-flow debug). Policy catalogue and screen setup remain available below. Start here Open Leave One-Stop Guide → Admin setup Leave Configuration → Policies catalogue Interactive data flow Toggle leave org/role flags live — trace fs_emp_leave_master_model , balance reserve, approve, and promotion without touching production. Primary simulator Leave request & approve → Also see Policy & accrual → All simulators Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step to jump. Matching flowchart nodes highlight as you go. flowchart TD A[Policy and balances ready] --> B[Apply] B --> C[Submit] C --> D[Approve or Reject] D --> E[Balance + timesheet] 1 Policy and balances ready Published leave policy plus balances from Employee leave config (OB import / Adjust balance) or accrual. 2 Apply Employee opens Leave Management, picks type and dates; day count uses their working week and holidays. 3 Submit Overlap and working-day checks run; pending balance is reserved; approver is notified. 4 Approve or Reject Manager or delegate decides. Reject requires a comment and releases pending balance. 5 Balance + timesheet On approve: debit ledger, promote leave TaskActivities, optional attendance sync. flowchart TD C[CREATED] --> S[SUBMITTED] S --> A[APPROVED] A --> P[Promoted / Synced] S --> R[REJECTED] S --> W[Withdraw / Cancel] W --> Rel[Pending released] R --> Rel 1 CREATED Draft leave after create; not yet in the manager queue. 2 SUBMITTED Awaiting approval; balance held as pending. 3 APPROVED Authority accepted; debit starts; promotion may still be pending/retrying. 4 Promoted / Synced Timesheet leave activities exist; attendance may show LEAVE when sync is on. 5 REJECTED Manager declines with comment; pending balance released. 6 Withdraw / Cancel Employee or HR stops the request per status rules. 7 Pending released Held days return to available after reject/withdraw. flowchart TD O[Open Leaves] --> B[Check balance] B --> A[Apply leave] A --> T[Pick type and dates] T --> D[Review day count] D --> V{Overlap or non-working only?} V -->|Yes| Fix[Fix dates] Fix --> T V -->|No| Sub[Submit for approval] 1 Open Leaves HRMS → Leaves (or People → Leaves) with leave module enabled. 2 Check balance Confirm available days for the leave type on the balance cards. 3 Apply leave Open the apply drawer from the header action. 4 Pick type and dates Choose leave type, from/to, optional half-day and reason. 5 Review day count Count excludes weekly offs and holidays for this employee. 6 Overlap / non-working check System blocks bad ranges; fix dates if needed. 7 Fix dates Adjust range until overlap and working-day rules pass. 8 Submit for approval Request becomes SUBMITTED and appears in the manager queue. flowchart TD P[Pending panel or Approvals inbox] --> Rev[Review dates and days] Rev --> Dec{Decision} Dec -->|Approve| Deb[Debit balance] Deb --> Pro[Promote TaskActivity] Pro --> Att[Attendance sync if flagged] Dec -->|Reject| Com[Reject + required comment] Com --> Rel[Pending balance released] 1 Open pending Leave Management pending panel or Workspace Approvals inbox. 2 Review Check employee, type, dates, day count, and reason. 3 Decision Approve or reject (reject needs a comment). 4 Debit balance Approved leave moves days from pending to used. 5 Promote TaskActivity Leave days appear on timesheet; retries if promotion fails. 6 Attendance sync When flagged, writes LEAVE / HALF_DAY on the attendance matrix. 7 Reject + comment Employee is notified; request closed as REJECTED. 8 Pending released Held balance returns to available. flowchart TD Emp[Leave subject employeeId] --> Res[Working-day resolver] Res --> P1{Override?} P1 -->|Yes| WD[Workdays set] P1 -->|No| P2{Jurisdiction rule?} P2 -->|Yes| WD P2 -->|No| P3[Team / schedule / Mon-Fri] P3 --> WD WD --> Hol[Minus holidays] Hol --> Days[numberOfDays] 1 Leave subject Resolver uses the employee the leave is for — not only the team. 2 Working-day resolver Single service used by create, submit, promote, and the apply drawer. 3 Employee override? Personal working-day rule wins if assigned. 4 Workdays set ISO weekdays that count (e.g. 1–5 or 7,1–4 for Sun–Thu). 5 Jurisdiction rule? Country/region pattern if the employee is assigned a leave jurisdiction. 6 Team / schedule / Mon–Fri Team-default rule, then work schedule/shift, then Mon–Fri. 7 Minus holidays People holidays matching assigned calendar keys are excluded. 8 numberOfDays Server recalculates on create/submit; drawer estimate is guidance only. Overview HRMS → Leaves is the employee and manager hub for time off. When leaveManagementEnabled is on, you create and submit requests here; managers approve from the pending panel or Approvals inbox. Feature & use-case map Use case Who What happens View balances Employee Available / used / pending by type Apply full-day / half-day Employee Create + submit; day count from resolver Approve / reject Manager / delegate Debit + promote, or release pending Withdraw / cancel Employee / HR Balance reverse/release per status Related pages Leave Configuration Admin setup + configure flowcharts. Leave Policies User Guide Supported types, packs, configure, CFA map (tabs). Employee leave config OB template, dry-run import, Adjust balance. Attendance Leave sync and month matrix. Scenario: Apply leave Step-by-step employee flow. Scenario: Approve leave Manager approve/reject path. Scenario: OB bulk import Cutover balances before apply. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

Choose persona, module strip, or search the page list. 4 Toggle Off Disabled entries always win over Roles and page maps. 5 Save changes Writes org.json personaNavigationAdditional disable lists. 6 Users refresh Killed personas/pages stay hidden after login or hard refresh. flowchart TD A[Page access tab] --> B[Select one page] B --> C{Mode?} C -->|Product default| D[Use catalog personas] C -->|Custom| E[Toggle personas] E --> F[Save pagePersonaMap] D --> G[Empty override = catalog] F --> H[Org override for that path] G --> I[Sidebar + route guard] H --> I 1 Page access tab Second tab: edit one page at a time. 2 Select one page Filter by search, group, or overrides-only. 3 Mode? Product default keeps sidebar catalog personas; Custom seeds an override. 4 Toggle personas Allow only the personas that should open that route. 5 Save pagePersonaMap Stored under personaNavigationAdditional in Application Config. 6 Sidebar + route guard Menus and deep links respect the map after role persona modules. Roles vs Persona navigation Question Use Roles ( /admin/roles ) Use Persona navigation Which personas may this role switch to? ✓ Persona access tab → personaModules — Hide DELIVERY org-wide for everyone? Link to Persona navigation ✓ Turn off tab Only MANAGER may open Leave page? ✓ Page preview (writes org map) ✓ Page access tab Module CRUD matrix? ✓ Advanced tab — Interactive trace: Roles simulator (role layer) · Persona navigation simulator (org layer). Overview Admin → Persona navigation is the simplified org editor for access kill switches and per-page persona maps. Role-level “who may use a persona” still lives on Roles & permissions . Protected paths (Roles, Persona navigation, App Config, Setup checklist) cannot be turned off. Evaluation order: role menu flags → role personaModules → org pagePersonaMap when present → org disable lists (always win). How to use 1. Turn off what the org should not see On Turn off , disable personas, modules, or search and turn individual pages Off. 3. Customize a page when needed On Page access , select a route, choose Custom, toggle personas, then Save. 4.
