pages.content: Employee Profile — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Employee Profile Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause or click a step. flowchart TD Hero[Profile hero] --> Nav[Tab nav] Nav --> View[Active view] View --> Save[Save changes] 1 Profile hero Photo, role, KPI glance. 2 Tab nav Personal, leave, security, etc. 3 Active view Edit fields for that tab. 4 Save changes Persist where editable. Overview /hrms/profile/:employeeId — opened from Employees list or account menu. Shows hero header with photo, role, team, and side navigation between sections. Screen layout Hero: Name, title, team, status, avatar. Side nav: General · Security · Notifications · Account activity. Content: Section-specific forms and read-only fields. Activity tab: Timeline with activity charts. Header & filters No SHOW/SORT. Section tabs only. Edit availability depends on whether you view your own profile vs another employee (admin/HR). Summary & charts The Lux summary strip at the top of this screen is collapsible. Expand it to reveal KPI tiles and chart panels; collapse it for a wider register. All charts respect your active filters (SHOW preset, team scope, date range, text search). ◆ Emerald Luxury UI theme · chart data refreshes when filters change Account activity section includes activity timeline charts showing login and action patterns over time. Main content & actions Update general info, reset security settings, configure notification preferences, review activity log. Complete feature list Every control, panel, and workflow on this screen. ✓ Luxury UI shell Emerald-themed glass cards, sticky gradient header, module sidebar, and responsive layout. ✓ Documentation search Header search indexes all guide pages (docs site). ✓ Profile hero Photo, name, role, team, contact details. ✓ Security tab Password, MFA, session management. ✓ Notifications tab Email and in-app preference toggles. ✓ Activity tab Recent actions and login history. ✓ Skills & org Tags, department, manager, employment type. ✓ Edit mode Self-service or HR edit depending on permissions. Before you start 💡 First login Upload photo, verify contact info, enable MFA, then review Notifications tab. 📝 SSO accounts Password fields hidden when SSO-only — use corporate IdP for credential changes. Who uses this screen Every employee viewing or editing their own profile; HR administrators editing any employee record opened from the Employees register. Managers may view limited fields for direct reports. ℹ️ Person record detail Profile is the single place for photo, contact info, skills, org placement, security settings, and activity history — distinct from org-wide Settings defaults. Key concepts Profile hero Photo, display name, job title, team, manager, and primary contact channels. Tabbed sections Overview, Security, Notifications, Activity, Skills & org — layout varies by permission. Edit mode Inline or modal edits for fields your role may change — HR edits more than self-service. Security tab Password change, MFA enrollment, active sessions — critical for enterprise SSO hybrids. Activity tab Recent logins and significant actions for security awareness. Permissions Role Access on this screen Individual contributor Edit own contact, photo, notification prefs, password/MFA; view own activity. People manager View direct report profiles; limited field edit (e.g., skills) per policy. HR administrator Full edit on any employee opened from register. Self only (contractor) Restricted tab set — no org admin fields. 📝 Administrator override Org administrators and service accounts configured in the Admin console may bypass row-level scopes shown above. When in doubt, confirm access with your Tracopus administrator. Controls reference Control Description Notes Edit profile Toggle edit on hero fields. Save validates email format. Photo upload Avatar image for Lux shell header. Max size per org policy. Security tab Password, MFA, sessions. SSO users may hide password. Notifications tab Email and in-app toggles per event. Overrides global Settings defaults. Activity tab Login history and actions. Read-only. Skills & org Tags, department, manager link. HR editable. Deactivate (HR) Status change for leavers. HR admin only from register context. Common mistakes ⚠️ Using personal email as primary Breaks SSO and password reset — use corporate email from day one. ⚠️ Skipping MFA setup Enterprise policy may enforce MFA on next login — configure proactively in Security tab. ⚠️ Managers editing compensation Comp fields usually HR-only — well-meaning edits create audit violations. FAQ How is Profile different from Settings? Profile is identity and security; Settings is preferences (locale, timesheet defaults) applying to your account. Can I change my manager? Usually HR-only — self-service manager change would break approval chains. Who sees Activity tab? You see your own; HR may see others when opened from Employees register. Does photo sync to mobile? Yes — avatar appears in mobile app header after save. Related pages Settings Personal preferences separate from identity. Employees Register opens Profile for any row. Employee Dashboard Personal analytics for this user. Mobile Login Security settings affect mobile sign-in. Workflows Open profile from Employees or account menu. Navigate sections via side nav. Save changes per section. Tips & best practices Tip: Security section covers password and SSO linkage — direct employees to Getting Started for first login. More guidance 💡 Remember Photo, display name, job title, team, manager, and primary contact channels. ℹ️ How is Profile different from Settings? Profile is identity and security; Settings is preferences (locale, timesheet defaults) applying to your account. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved. Sections: Mobile device registration · Schedulers · Service health · Company information · Localization · Notification preferences. Header & filters No list filters. Each section is a self-contained form panel. Access requires admin/settings permission. Summary & charts Service health may show status indicators; schedulers list cron jobs with enable/disable toggles. Main content & actions Configure org-wide defaults: company branding info, locale formats, notification routing, registered mobile devices. Complete feature list Every control, panel, and workflow on this screen. ✓ Luxury UI shell Emerald-themed glass cards, sticky gradient header, module sidebar, and responsive layout. ✓ Documentation search Header search indexes all guide pages (docs site). ✓ Personal preferences Locale, timezone, display options. ✓ Notification rules Per-event email/push toggles. ✓ Timesheet defaults Preferred entry type and week start. ✓ Integration tokens API keys or connected apps (if enabled). Before you start 💡 Traveling workers Update timezone before logging travel-week timesheet entries. ℹ️ Notification digest Enable weekly digest if daily email volume is too high. Who uses this screen Every Tracopus user configuring personal preferences that apply across HRMS and linked modules — locale, notifications, and timesheet defaults. Not for org-wide admin (see Admin guide). ℹ️ Personal preferences only Settings changes affect only your account — unlike Employees register which is HR-managed org data. Key concepts Locale & display Language, timezone, date format — drives how timesheet weeks and invoice periods render for you. Notification rules Per-event email and push toggles overriding system defaults. Timesheet defaults Preferred entry type and week-start preference where configurable. Integration tokens Personal API keys or connected apps when enabled by org. Lux theme note App palette may follow org default; guide site has separate palette switcher. Permissions Role Access on this screen Individual contributor Full personal settings scope. People manager Same personal scope — no team settings here. HR administrator Personal settings plus separate admin console for org config. All roles Integration tokens visible only if feature licensed. 📝 Administrator override Org administrators and service accounts configured in the Admin console may bypass row-level scopes shown above. When in doubt, confirm access with your Tracopus administrator. Controls reference Control Description Notes Locale picker Language and region. Refresh may be required. Timezone Affects due dates and week boundaries. Match your work location. Notification toggles Per event type on/off. Syncs to mobile push where enabled. pages.content: Timesheet Approval Scenarios — Coverage Map Tracopus · HRMS · Timesheet Timesheet approval scenarios Standalone coverage map of the timesheet approval lifecycle: draft, submit, approve, reopen, resubmit, reject, unlock, auto-approve, and how hours land in work items ( TaskActivity / source=TIMESHEET ). 9 scenarios covered 9 scenarios pass 7 lifecycle steps 1 optional E2E watch Verdict: Core lifecycle is coherent end-to-end. Week status, day rows, and TIMESHEET work items stay aligned through approve → reopen → resubmit → approve/reject. Partial-week ( partialWeekSubmissionEnabled ) adds submission batches on top of the same week/day model — toggle it in the interactive data-flow simulator . Partial-week submission ( partialWeekSubmissionEnabled ) Flag Submit Pending unit Edit while pending Approve / reject Inbox id OFF (default) Full week One week row Week locked /timesheets/{weekId}/approve|reject WEEK:{id} ON Selected days ( activityDates ); multiple batches/week ts_timesheet_submission_model + day submission_id Leftover DRAFT/REJECTED days editable /timesheets/submissions/{id}/approve|reject SUBMISSION:{id} Requires timesheetApprovalEnabled . Fully APPROVED weeks still need reopen before edit. See evidence TIME-PARTIAL-WEEK-SUBMISSION.md . Happy path (status → work items) 1 Save draft Week stays DRAFT / REOPENED / REJECTED. Days → DRAFT. Work items unchanged. 2 Submit / Resubmit Week → PENDING_APPROVAL; clears prior approvedBy / rejection; REJECTED lines reactivated to ACTIVE. Work items not yet written (or remain demoted). 3 Approve Week → APPROVED. promoteWeek upserts TIMESHEET activities; leftover PENDING/DRAFT days cascade to APPROVED; orphans soft-deleted. 4 Reopen / Unlock Week → REOPENED; days → DRAFT. demoteWeek soft-deletes live TIMESHEET activities. Who: recorded approver, or manager if AUTO, or solo owner with no manager. 5 Edit + Resubmit Week → PENDING again; approval fields cleared. Work items stay demoted until next approve. 6a Approve again Revive/upsert via day.taskActivityId / natural key; soft-delete orphans. 6b Reject Week/days → REJECTED. demoteWeek ensures no live TIMESHEET hours remain. Scenarios covered S1 Draft → Submit → Approve Pass Employee saves staging, submits; manager approves. Hours become work items. Actors Employee → Manager Work items promoteWeek upsert; orphan soft-delete; leftover days cascade APPROVED Issue fixed Zero-duration days could stay PENDING after week APPROVED Fix cascadeNonRejectedDaysToApproved S2 Approve → Reopen → Edit → Resubmit → Re-approve Pass Full correction cycle after a prior promote. Actors Approver → Employee → Approver Work items demote on reopen; promote revives on re-approve Issue fixed Hours stayed live while REOPENED; orphan activities after day replace Fix demoteWeek + promote orphan cleanup S3 Approve → Reopen → Resubmit → Reject Pass Manager rejects after a prior promotion existed. Actors Approver → Employee → Approver Work items demoteWeek on reject — no live TIMESHEET rows Issue fixed Reject left APPROVED TaskActivities; utilization still showed hours Fix demoteWeek in processReject S4 Line reject → fix → Resubmit → Approve Pass Single line rejected, employee corrects, week resubmitted and approved. Actors Manager → Employee → Manager Work items Line reactivated ACTIVE; promote includes hours again Issue fixed lineStatus stuck REJECTED; promoteWeek skipped the line Fix reactivateRejectedLines + staging save reactivation S5 Dirty Save + Submit (first week) Pass Employee edits cells and clicks Submit while unsaved. Actors Employee Work items N/A until approve Issue fixed Save callback dropped payload; setState race missed weekId Fix Forward save payload into submit (TimesheetPage + Employee360) S6 Auto-approve-own then reopen Pass Submit with auto-approve → APPROVED ( approvalAuthorityType=AUTO ). Actors Employee (submit); Manager or solo owner (reopen) Work items Promoted on auto-approve path Issue fixed Employee always saw Reopen; solo owner with no manager was stuck Fix Has manager → only canAct reopens. No manager → owner may self-reopen S7 ADD TIME ENTRY by status Pass Header / board create CTA gated by week status. Allowed DRAFT, REJECTED, REOPENED Blocked PENDING, APPROVED, LOCKED Issue fixed ADD ENTRY clickable on APPROVED Fix canAddTimesheetEntry S8 Unlock locked week Pass LOCKED → unlock → REOPENED; days DRAFT; work items demoted. Actors Manager / delegate Work items demoteWeek on unlock Issue fixed Unlock left promoted hours live Fix demoteWeek in unlockWeeks S9 Orphan day replace after edit Pass Approve₁ → reopen → change hours on same date → re-approve (canonical day kept). Actors Employee → Approver Work items Old TIMESHEET activity soft-deleted; current reused/updated Issue fixed Extra work-item hours (e.g. 11h vs 9h) from superseded day Fix Canonical days by line+date + orphan activity soft-delete UI gates by status Status Employee Manager DRAFT ADD ENTRY · Save · Submit — PENDING Locked · no ADD · Remind Approve / Reject (not own week) APPROVED No ADD · Reopen only if AUTO + no manager Reopen if approvedBy, or canAct if AUTO REOPENED ADD · Edit · Resubmit View REJECTED ADD · Resubmit — LOCKED No ADD · blocked Unlock → REOPENED + demote Work-item reflection On approve — promote TimesheetPromotionService.promoteWeek writes TaskActivity with source=TIMESHEET , links day/week ids, approvalStatus=APPROVED . Soft-deletes orphans not kept. After demote, revive uses day.taskActivityId . On reject / reopen / unlock — demote demoteWeek soft-deletes live TIMESHEET activities for the week. Non-TIMESHEET sources (TASK_BOARD / LEGACY) are left alone. Day links kept for revive. Residual / watch Area Note Risk Solo auto-approve owner No reporting manager + AUTO: employee may self-reopen. With a manager, only manager/delegate canAct. Fixed Legacy weeks (null approvedBy) Reopen falls back to canAct (manager/delegate), not employee. By design Live staging / Playwright Unit/FE tests cover paths; full browser assert of work items after S2/S3 optional. pages.title: Timesheet Approval
pages.description: Submit weeks or day batches for manager approval, resolve conflicts, and lock payroll periods.
pages.content: Timesheet Approval — Tracopus User Guide Home → HRMS → Timesheet Approval Interactive data flow Same timesheet simulator — toggle partialWeekSubmissionEnabled for full-week vs day-batch pending, manager/delegate approve, and lock/reopen paths. Primary simulator Timesheet flags & approval → Delegation & inbox Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays steps when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step to jump. flowchart TD O[Open week] --> Sub[Submit] Sub --> Pend[Pending manager] Pend --> Dec{Decision} Dec -->|Approve| Apr[Approved] Dec -->|Reject| Rej[Reject + comment] Rej --> Fix[Employee fixes] Fix --> Sub Apr --> Lock[Payroll lock] 1 Open week Hours entered on Timesheet. 2 Submit Employee submits for approval. 3 Pending manager Appears in pending panel / Approvals. 4 Decision Approve or reject with comment. 5 Approved Week accepted for payroll. 6 Reject + comment Employee notified to fix. 7 Employee fixes Edit open week and resubmit. 8 Payroll lock Manager/HR locks; corrections need unlock. flowchart TD Pend[Pending week] --> Conf{Conflicts?} Conf -->|Yes| Modal[Conflict modal] Modal --> Resolve[Resolve / edit] Resolve --> Pend Conf -->|No| Approve[Approve] 1 Pending week Manager opens approval item. 2 Conflicts? Overlaps or policy violations. 3 Conflict modal Shows conflicting rows. 4 Resolve / edit Fix hours or send back. 5 Approve Proceed when clean. Overview Timesheet approval adds submit, manager review, conflict resolution, and payroll lock on top of the weekly grid. Delegation may allow acting approvers. Partial-week flag ( timesheetAdditional.partialWeekSubmissionEnabled , default off): Off — employee submits the full week; one pending week; week locked until approve/reject; inbox id WEEK:{id} . On — employee selects days (chips) and may submit multiple batches per week; each batch is a separate approval request ( ts_timesheet_submission_model ); leftover DRAFT/REJECTED days stay editable; approve/reject by submission; inbox id SUBMISSION:{id} . Fully APPROVED weeks still require reopen before edit. How to use 1. Employee submits Full week when partial is off; select day chips and submit a batch when partial is on. 2. Manager reviews Pending panel or Approvals inbox (week or submission card). 3. Resolve conflicts Clear overlaps before approve (scoped to the pending week or batch). 4. Lock when ready Payroll lock after cutoff when the week is fully approved. Related pages Timesheet Weekly entry grid. Audit Trail Week-level events. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.

pages.content: Luxury Interface — Tracopus User Guide Home → Luxury Interface Chapter 2 Luxury Interface How to navigate the updated shell — glass surfaces, collapsible analytics, icon rail shortcuts, and personalization that carries across web and mobile. Shell layout The Luxury UI uses a three-column mental model on desktop: Icon rail (narrow, leftmost) — persistent quick actions and personalization. Module sidebar — directory navigation for HRMS, Sales, or Project pages you have access to. Main canvas — page header, optional summary analytics strip, filters, and content (table, grid, kanban, or dashboard). On mobile, the module sidebar collapses; the header exposes grid/list/create shortcuts where applicable. Page header Every main page shows: Workspace kicker — HRMS, Sales, or Project label above the page title. Page title — e.g. "Project List", "Time Sheet", "Bid Requests". Global search field — type and press Enter to open /project/search with results across entities. Dropdown panels — Tasks, Chat, Notifications (quick previews with links to full pages). Account menu — Profile, Settings, Sign out (or Microsoft logout when using SSO). Tip: Use header search for fast jumps to projects, tasks, or people instead of drilling through menus. Module sidebar Under Directories , expand HRMS, Sales, or Project to see permitted menu items. Items you cannot access are hidden entirely — not grayed out. The company chip below the logo shows your default team name, helping you confirm organizational context. Typical Project menu items Dashboard, Project List, Team capacity, Accounts, Notes, Taskboard, Task Activity, Reports, Feedback. Typical HRMS menu items Dashboard, Employees, Attendance, Time Sheet, Invoice. Typical Sales menu items Bid Requests, Purchase Orders. Icon rail The narrow rail on the far left provides cross-module shortcuts: Icon Action Search Opens global search page Taskboard Jump to kanban view Calendar Personal work calendar (access-controlled) Notes Quick notes overlay / Notes page Chat Messaging (access-controlled) Files File manager (access-controlled) Palette droplet Color theme picker App config Application configuration tree (admin) Settings Right sidebar with layout & font options Today Today activity sidebar Avatar User menu duplicate of header account Global search Type your query in the header search field. Press Enter to navigate to the search results page. Results are grouped by entity type; click a row to open the detail view. Search respects your access permissions — you only see records your role allows. Themes & color palettes Twelve curated palettes change primary, accent, and soft background tokens across the entire app. Emerald is the default theme for this documentation site. Your choice is saved in browser storage ( docs-lux-palette for this guide; the live app stores your palette preference separately and syncs to mobile). Preview palettes Click a swatch to preview — saved locally in this documentation site and synced with the live app key. Available palettes Indigo (default), Sapphire, Emerald, Rose, Midnight, Amber, Violet, Ocean, Sunset, Graphite, Crimson, Forest. Midnight and Graphite apply a darker shell treatment. Change palette via: icon rail droplet, Settings right sidebar link, or the preview grid above (syncs with the live app). Typography & layout settings Open Settings from the icon rail to adjust: Font family — Inter (default), Source Sans 3, IBM Plex Sans, Plus Jakarta Sans, DM Sans, Roboto, Open Sans, Lato, Manrope, Montserrat, and more. Layout toggles — compact sidebar and related display preferences. Font choice is stored in the app UI settings (browser local storage) and applied via data-lux-font on the document root. Summary panels List and dashboard pages open with a collapsible Lux summary section containing: KPI strip (counts, totals, percentages) Highlight / insight cards with stacked bar segments Stage flow or funnel diagrams (horizontal pipelines) Chart gallery (donut, bar, area, line panels — see Charts reference ) Collapse state is remembered per page in localStorage so your preference persists between visits. List page controls Most register pages (projects, employees, bids, etc.) share a filter bar: Team selection — multi-select checkbox menu to scope data Filter list… — free-text search within the current result set SHOW — status preset (Active, Archived, My projects, etc.) SORT — field and direction Date range — where applicable (projects, reports) Quick filter chips — one-click presets below the summary Grid / List toggle — switch table vs card grid Create — opens sidebar wizard or form (permission-gated) Create wizards vs forms Major create flows offer Wizard and Form modes via a toggle at the top of the sidebar: Project — 6+ steps: setup, client & study, service scope, fieldwork, compliance, team & estimates Purchase order — contract core, client, delivery scope, references Bid request — study basics, setup, screening, additional, quota Employee — profile, access, sign-in, organization, skills Use Wizard for guided first-time creation; switch to Form for quick edits by experts. Use this guide for onboarding, QA test scripts, and day-to-day help when you need to complete a task in Tracopus. ℹ️ How this guide is organized Pick a module below, then a feature , then open the scenario you need. Each scenario includes permissions , org/feature flags , warnings , role-specific behavior notes , numbered steps, verification checklist, and links to screen reference docs. ⚠️ Before you test Confirm Application Config flags and role permissions for your pilot org unit. Behavior changes when flags are off — menus hide rather than show disabled controls. Use persona-specific test accounts (employee, manager, HR admin). Feature (e.g. Employees) → Scenario (e.g. Create a new employee) → Steps (numbered actions) Screen documentation This guide covers how to complete workflows . For page-by-page screen reference — charts, filters, permissions tables, and FAQs — use the main documentation. pages.title: My Approvals
pages.description: Universal approval inbox — filter by status, domain, and priority, then approve or reject without leaving the page.
pages.content: My Approvals — Tracopus User Guide Home → Workspace → My Approvals Interactive data flow Universal inbox merges leave, timesheet, and attendance pending rows — delegation scopes control who can act. Primary simulator Approval delegation & inbox → All simulators Flowcharts Each diagram auto-plays when it scrolls into view. Use Play / Pause , or click a step to jump. flowchart TD A[Open My Approvals] --> B[Filter pending] B --> C[Open request] C --> D{Approve or Reject} D -->|Approve| E[Optional comment] D -->|Reject| F[Comment required] E --> G[Inbox refreshes] F --> G 1 Open My Approvals Workspace → My approvals (or header shortcut when enabled). 2 Filter pending Status defaults to Pending. Narrow by domain, priority, or search. 3 Open request Click a register row to open the detail drawer. 4 Approve or Reject Approve may allow an optional comment; reject usually requires one. 5 Inbox refreshes List and KPIs update after the action succeeds. flowchart TD S[SLA banner] --> H[Review high priority] H --> I[Pending + High filter] I --> R[Clear overdue first] A2[Analytics tab] --> D2[Domain bottlenecks] 1 SLA banner Appears when items are overdue or due within 48 hours. 2 Review high priority Banner CTA focuses Pending + High priority. 3 Analytics tab Hero nav switches to queue health by domain and aging. Overview My Approvals aggregates decisions you (or you as delegate) can take across HRMS and delivery domains. Source records stay in their modules; this page is the action inbox, not a second data store. How to use 1. Start on Pending Status chips default to Pending. Use All only when auditing history. 2. Narrow the queue Domain and Priority dropdowns, plus search on requester/subject/module. 3. Act from the drawer Open a row, review context, approve or reject, then refresh if needed. 4. Save a view Use saved views for recurring filters (e.g. Leave + High). Related pages Timesheet Approval Domain-specific timesheet decisions. Leave Management Leave requests that feed the inbox. Notification templates Emails and in-app copy for approval events. © 2026 Tracopus . All rights reserved.
